liturgical_title: Memorial of Saint Augustine, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
first_reading_text: Brothers and sisters, we ask and urge you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, just as you are doing, that you do so more and more.
psalm_response: R. Rejoice in the Lord, you just!
psalm_text: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be glad! Clouds and thick darkness are all around him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
gospel_acclamation: Alleluia, alleluia. Stay awake! For you do not know when the Son of Man will come.
gospel_text: Jesus told his disciples this parable: 'The Kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom. Five of them were foolish and five were wise.'
